Hamza Khushaim will lead the company’s growth strategy in the two GCC countries

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

State Street Corporation, a New York Stock Exchange-listed financial services provider, has appointed Hamza Khushaim as CEO and Country Head for Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, as part of the company’s expansion plans in the two GCC nations.

In his new role, Khushaim will lead State Street’s growth strategy in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, working across investment services and the broader organisation, working with clients, regulators and government stakeholders. Based in the kingdom, he will also serve as CEO of State Street Saudi Arabia Financial Solutions, the firm’s regulated entity.

State Street has $59.2 trillion in assets under custody and/or administration and $6.3 trillion in assets under management as of September 30, 2026. It operates in more than 100 geographic markets and employs approximately 51,000 worldwide. The company also launched its MENA regional headquarters in Riyadh in October 2025.
